name: SystemKeywords
_readme: Used by SystemClassificationService to disambiguate piping systems that Revit's own System Classification reports as 'Other' (Revit has no built-in classification for Medical Gas or, in many templates, Storm drainage). Revit's RBS_SYSTEM_CLASSIFICATION_PARAM (Sanitary/Vent/Domestic/Hydronic/Fire) is always checked FIRST and takes priority over these keywords. Edit the lists below to match this project's naming convention, then use Settings to reload — no recompile needed. A copy of this file is also kept at %APPDATA%\ClashResolveAI\Rules\SystemKeywords.json, which is the file actually read at runtime; this shipped copy is just the starting template.
